chapters.summary: Council Staff conducts a microphone check, notes the date and recording by Simone Eno, and welcomes attendees to the NYC Council Parks and Recreation committee vote.
chapters.title: Staff conducts microphone check and opens Parks and Recreation vote

utterances.speaker: Council Staff
utterances.text: This is a microphone check for the Committee on Parks and Recreation, recorded in the committee room.

utterances.speaker: Council Staff
utterances.text: Today's date, October 22, 2026, recorded by Simone Eno.

utterances.speaker: Council Staff
utterances.text: Welcome to today's committee vote for the

utterances.speaker: Council Staff
utterances.text: Good morning and welcome to New York City Council vote on parks and recreation.

chapters.summary: Staff asks everyone to silence electronic devices and tells the Chair he may begin.
chapters.title: Staff instructs attendees to silence devices and yields to Chair

utterances.speaker: Council Staff
utterances.text: At this time, we're asking everyone to size all electronic devices, and no time, no one should approach the S.

chapters.summary: Ty Hankerson identifies himself as Chair of the Committee on Parks and Recreation and thanks attendees.
chapters.title: Chair Hankerson opens hearing and introduces himself

utterances.speaker: Ty Hankerson
utterances.text: I'm Ty Hankerson, Chair of the Committee on Parks and Recreation.

chapters.summary: Hankerson welcomes attendees to the hearing and states they will vote on proposed Intro 927A, which was considered by the committee on September 30, 2026.
chapters.title: Chair announces vote on Intro 927A after September 30 hearing

utterances.speaker: Ty Hankerson
utterances.text: I'd like to welcome all of you to this hearing where we will vote on proposed Intro 927A, which was considered by the committee on September 30th, 2026.

chapters.summary: Hankerson explains Intro 927A would rename Shorefront Parkway between Beach 32nd Street and Beach 56th Place as Edgemere Avenue.
chapters.title: Chair describes renaming Shorefront Parkway as Edgemere Avenue

utterances.speaker: Ty Hankerson
utterances.text: Proposed Intro 927A would officially rename Shorefront Parkway between Beach 32nd Street and Beach 56th Place.

chapters.summary: Hankerson says the renaming restores the street's original historical name and resolves years of confusion, especially mail delivery.
chapters.title: Chair cites historical name restoration and mail delivery confusion

utterances.speaker: Ty Hankerson
utterances.text: This would restore the street to its original and historical name and clear up a lot of confusion, specifically relating to mail delivery that has arisen over the years.

chapters.summary: Hankerson congratulates Councilmember Selvena Brooks-Powers for proposing the bill and urges committee colleagues to vote in favor.
chapters.title: Chair congratulates Brooks-Powers and urges yes vote on Intro 927A

utterances.speaker: Ty Hankerson
utterances.text: I'd like to congratulate my colleague, Councilmember Salvina Brooks-Powers,

utterances.speaker: Ty Hankerson
utterances.text: who proposed this piece of legislation, and I urge all of my colleagues on the committee to vote in favor of the bill.

chapters.summary: Hankerson asks the clerk to call the roll on Intro 927A.
chapters.title: Chair turns roll call over to committee clerk

utterances.speaker: Ty Hankerson
utterances.text: Now I'd like to turn it over to the clerk to call the roll.

chapters.summary: Committee Clerk Ben Jacobs identifies himself and announces a roll call vote on Intro 927A.
chapters.title: Clerk Ben Jacobs opens roll call on Intro 927A

utterances.speaker: Council Staff
utterances.text: Ben Jacobs, Committee Clerk, Committee on Parks and Recreation.

chapters.summary: Clerk calls members; Chair Hankerson and members Krishnan, Lee, Marte, Nurse, Sanchez, Ung, Santosuosso, and Morano vote aye or yes.
chapters.title: Roll call vote on Intro 927A

chapters.summary: Clerk thanks members, reports 11 affirmative votes, none negative, no abstentions, and declares the item adopted.
chapters.title: Clerk announces 11-0 vote and adoption of Intro 927A

utterances.speaker: Council Staff
utterances.text: That is a vote of 11 in the affirmative, none in the negative, and no abstentions.

chapters.summary: Hankerson thanks the clerk, closes the vote, and adjourns the hearing.
chapters.title: Chair Hankerson closes vote and adjourns meeting

utterances.speaker: Ty Hankerson
utterances.text: With that, we can close the vote.

chapters.summary: After adjournment, a Council Staff member remarks, "Too many things today, man."
chapters.title: Staff comment after adjournment

summary: The Committee on Parks and Recreation held a hearing and vote on Intro 927A to rename Shorefront Parkway between Beach 32nd Street and Beach 56th Place as Edgemere Avenue in Queens.
Chair Ty Hankerson described the bill as restoring the street's historical name and reducing mail delivery confusion, and congratulated Councilmember Selvena Brooks-Powers for proposing it.
The committee voted 11-0 to adopt Intro 927A, with no abstentions, and the Chair adjourned the meeting.
title: Committee on Parks and Recreation
topic: Renaming one thoroughfare and public place in the Borough of Queens, Edgemere Avenue, and to amend the official map of the city of New York accordingly
